messages:
Marta: Opening a small docs PR to add a compact "Ask & Fix" section to the Optimize toolkit. Goal: short copy-paste fixes for customers who hit streaming stalls after switching quant profiles. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/9782 :link:
Hiro: Nice. Can the section include 1-line fixes (curl/jq + SDK toggles) so support can paste them into replies? Keep it tiny.
Marta: Yes 1 will include three 1-line recipes: (A) verify SSE headers + streaming, (B) quick per-request prefetch toggle, (C) quick switch-out quant profile and rebench.
Jae: For A can you add this check to confirm SSE vs chunked: `curl -i -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=rwd-3" | head -n 10` and a short note "look for HTTP/1.1 200 and event: message"
Marta: Exactly. For B I'll add both JS and CLI variants. JS snippet (one-liner): `await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-3', input: 'x', prefetch: { enabled: false } })` and CLI metric check: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.ai/api/metrics?name=kv_prefetch_miss_rate&range=5m" | jq .`
Nora: Add a tiny caution line: toggling prefetch may temporarily increase p95 while caches warm. That saved us in a support call yesterday.
Marta: Good catch. For C I'm adding a tiny example to compare q8-balanced vs q4_0 with a perf script: `./perf/run.sh --model rwd-3 --quant q8-balanced` and note expected quick observation: memory ~x1.6 vs float32 (approx).
Hiro: Also include an explicit "when to escalate to infra/support" checklist: repeated OOMs after quant change, streaming p95 >500ms for 5+ minutes, or sustained kv_prefetch_miss_rate >0.2. Makes triage faster.
Jae: Editorial nit: avoid the phrase "turn off batching". Prefer exact config keys: `Batching.MaxBatchMs=0` or `batching.enabled=false` so readers know the knob.
Marta: Will update wording. docs-bot: scheduling snippet-lint and link-check on PR open.
docs-bot: Note: I'll flag any internal-only console URLs and suggest replacements if possible.
Nora: Tiny UX ask: add a one-line fallback to recommend running the mixed-workload CI example if teams want to reproduce locally before rolling changes. Link to examples/ci/mixed_workload.sh.
Marta: Added. ETA pushing PR in ~45m and will ping for review. :rocket:
